definitions.gloss: complaint; grumbling; whining about one's troubles
definitions.explanation: Expressing dissatisfaction or complaints about problems, often repeatedly and without seeking a solution.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{愚痴|ぐち}を{聞|き}いてくれる？
examples.english: Would you listen to me complain about work?

examples.japanese: {愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}っても{何|なに}も{変|か}わらない。
{彼|かれ}は{愚痴|ぐち}ばかり{言|い}っている。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う / こぼす (to complain)
・{愚痴|ぐち}を{聞|き}く (to listen to complaints)
・{愚痴|ぐち}っぽい (prone to complaining)
・{愚痴|ぐち}ばかり (nothing but complaints)

ORIGIN:
{愚痴|ぐち} is originally a Buddhist term meaning one of the three poisons ({三毒|さんどく}) - ignorance or delusion ({愚|ぐ} = foolish, {痴|ち} = ignorant).

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{文句|もんく} (complaint, objection) - more direct protest
・{不満|ふまん} (dissatisfaction) - general discontent
・{苦情|くじょう} (complaint) - formal complaint, often to businesses
